info.description:
# Introduction

Monoova has developed a powerful payments engine which allows you to receive, manage and pay funds in AUD in Australia automatically.

Contact Support:
 Name: Monoova Support
 Email: support@monoova.com

request.description:
Use this API to create a new whitelist entry for an automatcher account. Multiple source bank account numbers or bank account names can be whitelisted against each Automatcher number. The system will automatically return payments if the payment details do not match one of the entries.

Make sure to set the account status to “Enabled” to accept payments for the set of rules defined, the status can always be updated if the rule no longer applies using the update endpoint.
